# Calibration Results — Layer 1 Content-Signature Scorer

Generated by `scripts/run-calibration.ts` against `tests/fixtures/calibration/labeled-files.json`.
Regenerate with `npx tsx scripts/run-calibration.ts`.

## Corpus

- Labeled files: 50
- Scorable (Lua, non-encrypted): 36
- Null-scored (encrypted / binary / missing): 14
- Stratum counts (labels): config=13, logic=12, data=11, encrypted=14

## Confusion matrix per threshold — full corpus

Null-scored files (encrypted / empty) are excluded from metrics — they cannot be classified by this heuristic and are guarded before scoring. Everything else is in.

## Confusion matrix per threshold — production-realistic (data/** path-excluded)

In production the content-signature rule only fires on files NOT caught by path rules (§Layer 1). `data/**` is explicitly off the path list AND excluded here, so this matrix reflects what the scorer actually sees: config-candidate Lua vs logic Lua. This is the matrix the threshold is chosen against.
